agg.help:
Detect cell-type aggregates (e.g. TLS) and write namespaced outputs.

     
    Outputs written to <results-dir>/:
      model-outputs-csv/<slide>.csv      gains object_<name>_prob_<name> column
      agg-<name>-outputs-csv/<slide>.csv  one row per aggregate (hplot-consumable)
      graphs/<slide>.h5                   gains an agg/<name>/ quotient-graph group
agg.name: agg

params.help: Directory containing whole slide images.  Used only to enumerate slides and resolve µm-per-pixel spacing; images are not fully read during agg.
params.name: wsi_dir

params.help: Directory holding WSInsight inference outputs.  Must contain a ``model-outputs-csv/`` subdirectory produced by ``wsinsight infer`` or ``wsinsight run``.
params.name: results_dir

params.help: Product label for this aggregate (lower-case [a-z0-9_]+), e.g. 'tls'.  Namespaces every artifact (object_<name>_prob_<name> column, agg-<name>-outputs-csv/, agg/<name>/ in the graph cache) and is usable as a type in `wsinsight hplot --target-by aggregate`.
params.name: agg_name

params.help: Comma-separated ingredient cell types that may join the aggregate, e.g. 't_cell,b_cell'.
params.name: agg_types

params.help: Maximum distance (µm) between neighboring cells in the Delaunay graph.
params.name: agg_max_neighbor_distance

params.help: k-hop neighborhood radius for the density gate.
params.name: agg_k

params.help: Minimum neighborhood size for a cell to be inside an aggregate region.
params.name: agg_n

params.help: Minimum fraction of ingredient cells in the neighborhood (density gate).
params.name: agg_r

params.help: Drop aggregates with fewer than this many cells.
params.name: agg_min_size

params.help: Recompute and overwrite existing per-slide agg outputs for this name.
params.name: overwrite

params.help: Number of slides to process concurrently.
params.name: num_workers

ecomp.help:
Compute edge-level neighborhood composition for WSInsight inference outputs.

    For every Delaunay edge (two cells connected in the triangulation), the
    k-hop neighboring edges are collected from the line graph and the
    proportion of each edge type in that neighborhood is recorded.

     
    Outputs written to <results-dir>/:
      ecomp-outputs-csv/<slide_id>.csv   per-edge neighborhood composition
ecomp.name: ecomp

params.help: Directory containing whole slide images.  Used only to enumerate slides and to resolve µm-per-pixel spacing; images are not fully read during ecomp.
params.name: wsi_dir

params.help: Directory holding WSInsight inference outputs.  Must contain a ``model-outputs-csv/`` subdirectory produced by ``wsinsight infer`` or ``wsinsight run``.
params.name: results_dir

params.help: Maximum Delaunay edge length (µm); longer edges are pruned before building the line graph.
params.name: ecomp_max_edge

params.help: Number of hops that define the edge-level neighborhood radius (k-hop on the line graph).
params.name: ecomp_k

params.help: Recompute and overwrite existing per-slide ecomp outputs.
params.name: overwrite

params.help: Number of slides to process concurrently.
params.name: num_workers

params.help: Skip line-graph construction and k-hop aggregation.  Output one row per Delaunay edge with geometry, cell types, edge type, and a ``center_region`` column (derived from per-vertex ``region_prob_*`` columns).  Much faster; no ``neighborhood_*`` columns are written.
params.name: no_neighborhood

export.help:
Merge per-cell analytics and export to GeoJSON / OME-CSV / H5AD.

    Reads whatever analysis outputs are present under RESULTS_DIR:

     
    Per-cell sources (merged into one CSV per slide):
      model-outputs-csv/       — base inference probabilities (always included)
      hplot-outputs-csv/cells/ — H-Plot per-cell layer features
      ncomp-outputs-csv/       — node-level (cell) composition features
      niche-outputs-csv/cells/   — cell morphology embeddings
      imported-xenium/         — Xenium per-cell summaries

     
    Simplex sources (exported to separate directories):
      ecomp-outputs-csv/       — edge-level composition (per Delaunay edge)
      tcomp-outputs-csv/       — triad-level composition (per Delaunay triangle)
      agg-<name>-outputs-csv/  — aggregate-level features (e.g., TLS)

     
    When 'niche' is included and --geojson is set, the merged per-niche contour
    polygons in niche-outputs-csv/niches/ are also written to
    export-niche-regions-geojson/ (annotation polygons), mirroring
    'wsinsight niche --export-geojson'.

    At least one of --geojson, --omecsv, or --h5ad must be supplied.

    This command can be run at any time after inference — and optionally after
    hplot / ncomp / ecomp / tcomp / agg — without re-running the full pipeline.
export.name: export

params.help: Results directory produced by a prior wsinsight run / infer / hplot / ncomp invocation.  Must contain a model-outputs-csv/ subfolder.
params.name: results_dir

params.help: Export per-cell data to GeoJSON files (export-geojson/).
params.name: geojson

params.help: Export per-cell data to compressed OME-CSV files (export-omecsv/).  Compatible with QuPath and OMERO+.
params.name: omecsv

params.help: Export per-cell data to AnnData .h5ad files (export-h5ad/).  Compatible with scanpy / squidpy; cell centroids are stored in obsm['spatial'].
params.name: h5ad

params.help: Overlap ratio used during inference (must match the original run). Controls the tile-box shrinkage written into each exported feature.
params.name: patch_overlap_ratio

params.help: QuPath object-type label embedded in each exported GeoJSON / OME-CSV feature.
params.name: object_type

params.help: Worker processes used for parallel GeoJSON / OME-CSV serialisation.
params.name: export_workers

params.help: Re-build export CSVs even when export-csv/ already contains up-to-date files.  Useful after re-running hplot or ncomp.
params.name: overwrite

params.help: Analysis sources to include in the export (repeatable, or comma-separated). Per-cell sources (merged into export-csv/): hplot, ncomp, niche, xenium. Simplex sources (separate directories): ecomp, tcomp, agg:<name>. Special values: 'all' (everything), 'all-cells' (per-cell only). If omitted, only per-cell sources are included (backward compatible). Example: --include hplot,ncomp,ecomp --include agg:tls
params.name: include_sources

hplot.help: Run H-Plot analysis on inference outputs held inside ``results_dir``.
hplot.name: hplot

params.help: Directory containing whole slide images. This directory can *only* contain whole slide images.
params.name: wsi_dir

params.help: Directory to store results. If directory exists, will skip whole slides for which outputs exist.
params.name: results_dir

params.help: A parameter of float value determining maximal distance (um) to a neighboring cell.
params.name: hplot_max_neighbor_distance

params.help: Base cell type or cell type list that form(s) the cell cluster(s), e.g., tumor cells.
params.name: hplot_base_types

params.help: Target cell type or cell type list whose layer-wise proportion is computed, e.g., lymphocytes.
params.name: hplot_target_types

params.help: Interpret --base-types as cell types, niche ids, or aggregate names.
params.name: base_by

params.help: Interpret --target-types as cell types, niche ids, or aggregate names. Use 'niche' for a niche's layer-wise fraction (requires `wsinsight niche`); use 'aggregate' for an aggregate's member-cell fraction (requires `wsinsight agg`).
params.name: target_by

params.help: The maximal edge distance for defining the neighborhood of a cell.
params.name: hplot_k

params.help: The minimal neighborhood size for a cell to be computed for determining tumor regions.
params.name: hplot_n

params.help: The minimal ratio of tumor cells in the neighborhood of a cell, determining is this cell included in a tumor region.
params.name: hplot_r

params.help: The maximal layer index toward OUTSIDE of tumors for the range window of H-Plot.
params.name: hplot_range_max

params.help: The minimal layer index toward INSIDE of tumors for the range window of H-Plot.
params.name: hplot_range_min

params.help: H-Plot computing uses only samples with valid range of cellular-wise layers.
params.name: hplot_samples_with_valid_range_only

params.help: Overwrite existing H-Plot results instead of skipping slides that already have outputs.
params.name: overwrite

params.help: Number of slides to process concurrently.
params.name: num_workers

hplot-finalize.help:
Rebuild hplot-outputs.csv from per-slide intermediates.

    Use this after running parallel ``hplot`` jobs that share the same
    ``--results-dir``. Each worker writes its per-slide files; this command
    assembles the final aggregated CSV from all of them.
hplot-finalize.name: hplot-finalize

params.help: Results directory containing hplot per-slide outputs. The aggregated hplot-outputs.csv will be written here.
params.name: results_dir

params.help: Overwrite existing hplot-outputs.csv if it already exists.
params.name: overwrite

import.help:
Import spatial-transcriptomics gene expression onto WSInsight cells.

     
    For each sample in the sptx-list manifest:
      • map cell centroids (µm) onto the H&E via the ST2WSI transform,
      • match each cell to the nearest model-output detection,
      • write one AnnData whose obs carries EVERY model-output-csv column of the
        matched detection (prefixed ``model_``, NaN when a cell has no match) plus
        ``model_cell_id`` (== WSInsight's export-h5ad obs index), so the h5ad is
        self-contained and needs no join back to the CSV. Optional per-cell
        sources requested via ``--include`` are merged the same way under their
        own prefixes (``niche_`` / ``hplot_`` / ``ncomp_``).

     
    platform=xenium (default):
      sptx-list paths point to raw Xenium output directories.

     
    platform=xenium-h5ad:
      sptx-list paths point to sptxinsight annotated.h5ad files.
      The 3rd column of the sptx-list manifest supplies the per-sample
      ST2WSI transform directory (registration_params.json etc.).
      sptxinsight obs columns are carried over under the ``sptx_`` prefix.

     
    Output written to <results-dir>/:
      imported-xenium/<sample_id>.h5ad
import.name: import

params.help: Directory (or image-list://) of H&E slides. Matched to a sample by stem == manifest sample_id; provides the exact target dimensions used by the elastic (B-spline) transform.
params.name: wsi_dir

params.help: A sptx-list:// manifest (path<TAB>sample_id<TAB>transform_dir per line). Column 2 (sample_id) and column 3 (transform_dir) are optional. For platform=xenium: path points at each raw Xenium sample directory. For platform=xenium-h5ad: path points at each sptxinsight annotated.h5ad file.
params.name: sptx_dir

params.help: Directory holding WSInsight inference outputs (must contain model-outputs-csv/). imported-xenium/ is written here.
params.name: results_dir

params.help: Spatial-transcriptomics platform to import. 'xenium': read from raw Xenium output directories (cells.parquet + cell_feature_matrix.h5). 'xenium-h5ad': read from sptxinsight annotated.h5ad files (obsm['spatial'] + X); the sptx-list 3rd column supplies the per-sample ST2WSI transform directory.
params.name: platform

params.help: (platform=xenium-h5ad only) Key in adata.obsm holding cell centroids in microns.
params.name: spatial_key

params.help: ST2WSI coordinate transform: SIFT affine only, or affine + bUnwarpJ elastic B-spline (default; requires the H&E target dimensions), or 'none' to pass µm coordinates through unchanged (useful when the h5ad already contains pixel coordinates).
params.name: transform

params.help: 'all' (full panel, Gene Expression features) or a comma-separated list of gene names to import.
params.name: genes

params.help: Comma-separated optional per-cell sources to merge into obs, each under its own prefix: niche (niche_), hplot (hplot_), ncomp (ncomp_). The mandatory 'model' source (model_*) is always imported and need not be listed. Empty = model only. Example: --include niche,hplot
params.name: include

params.help: Maximum H&E-pixel distance for a cell↔detection match (0 = no cap; match_dist_px is always recorded so matches can be filtered later).
params.name: match_max_dist

params.help: Recompute and overwrite existing per-slide imports.
params.name: overwrite

params.help: QC only: compute and report the cell↔detection match hit-rate and median match distance per sample, without reading expression or writing any h5ad. Use it to check a manifest pairing / registration before a full import.
params.name: dry_run

infer.help:
Execute WSInsight inference and optional post-processing on prepared patches.

    The command consumes an existing `results_dir` (typically produced by `wsinsight
    patch` or `wsinsight run`) that already contains patch-level HDF5 data whose
    metadata enumerates the processed slides. Depending on the arguments, it either
    loads a registered model,
    a custom config/model-path pair, or synthesizes a pseudo-model from QuPath
    detections/annotations. After validating the requested patch geometry, the
    selected model is run via `run_inference`, producing CSV outputs under
    `model-outputs-csv`.

    Optional switches then:
        • synchronize metadata about the full session to `infer_metadata_*.json`.

    Use ``wsinsight export`` to convert results to GeoJSON / OME-CSV.
    Use ``wsinsight hplot`` / ``wsinsight ncomp`` for downstream spatial analytics.

    The function treats all input/output paths as `URIPath` values, materializing
    local copies only when dependencies such as pandas/geopandas require filesystem
    paths. Usage mirrors the CLI: `wsinsight infer --results-dir ... [options]`.
infer.name: infer

params.help: Optional directory containing whole slide images; inferred patches remain the primary input.
params.name: wsi_dir

params.help: Hidden argument for orchestrators to pass explicit slide paths alongside cached patches.
params.name: slide_paths

params.help: Directory to store results. If directory exists, will skip whole slides for which outputs exist.
params.name: results_dir

params.help: Results directory from a prior region-level (patch-based) wsinsight run containing a model-outputs-csv/ folder. Requires --object-based: each detected object is matched to its enclosing region and the region's class probabilities are added as region_prob_* columns in the output.
params.name: region_inference_dir

params.help: Directory of QuPath TSV detection-measurement exports (one <slide>.txt per slide containing 'Centroid X µm', 'Centroid Y µm', classification columns). Patches are extracted as fixed-size squares centered on each centroid. For GeoJSON detection exports, use --qupath-geojson-detection-dir instead.
params.name: qupath_measurement_detection_dir

params.help: Directory containing geojson files generated by QuPath. The detection in the geojson files will be used.
params.name: qupath_geojson_detection_dir

params.help: Directory containing QuPath annotation geojson files; their region labels seed the pseudo-model.
params.name: qupath_geojson_annotation_dir

params.help: The patch size of the pseudo model generated using QuPath detection files.
params.name: qupath_detection_patch_size

params.help: The patch size of the pseudo model generated using QuPath annotation files.
params.name: qupath_annotation_patch_size

params.help: The spacing um/px of the pseudo model generated using QuPath annotation/detection files.
params.name: qupath_spacing_um_px

params.help: Use QuPath 'name' fields as classes instead of the default Classification column when ingesting detection/annotation data.
params.name: qupath_name_as_class

params.help: Name of the model to use from WSInsight Model Zoo. Mutually exclusive with --config.
params.name: model_name

params.help: Path to configuration for the trained model. Use this option if the model weights are not registered in wsinsight. Mutually exclusive with--model
params.name: config

params.help: Path to the pretrained model. Use only when --config is passed. Mutually exclusive with --model.
params.name: model_path

params.help: Path to a folder containing config.json and torchscript_model.pt. Shorthand for --config + --model-path. Mutually exclusive with --model, --config, and --model-path.
params.name: zoo_model_dir

params.help: Batch size during model inference. If using multiple GPUs, increase the batch size.
params.name: batch_size

params.help: Dataloader workers that feed patches to PyTorch (n=0 runs single-threaded). Default heuristics use min(2 × GPU count, CPU count).
params.name: num_workers

params.help: Thread pool size used when TileFuse stitches object-based detections.
params.name: stitch_workers

params.help: Pin DataLoader tensors to CUDA memory for faster host-to-device transfer.  Disable (--no-pin-memory) in memory-constrained environments where DataLoader workers are being killed by the system OOM killer.
params.name: pin_memory

params.help: The ratio of overlap among patches. The default value of 0 produces non-overlapping patches. A value in (0, 1) will produce overlapping patches. Negative values will add space between patches. A value of -1 would skip every other patch. A value of 0.5 will provide 50%% of overlap between patches. Values must be in (-inf, 1).
params.name: patch_overlap_ratio

params.help: The size of patch in um. The default value of 0 produces full patch size of the chosen model.
params.name: patch_size_um

params.help: The size of patch in pixel. The default value of 0 produces full patch size of the chosen model.
params.name: patch_size_px

params.help: Overwrite existing outputs instead of skipping slides that already have results.  Currently controls region_* column replacement when --region-inference-dir is used.
params.name: overwrite

ncomp.help:
Compute neighborhood composition for each cell in WSInsight inference outputs.

    For every cell (cell type determined by the highest ``prob_*`` score),
    the k-hop Delaunay graph neighbors are collected and the proportion of each
    cell type in that neighborhood is recorded.

     
    Outputs written to <results-dir>/:
      ncomp-outputs-csv/<slide_id>.csv   per-cell neighborhood composition
ncomp.name: ncomp

params.help: Directory containing whole slide images.  Used only to enumerate slides and to resolve µm-per-pixel spacing; images are not fully read during ncomp.
params.name: wsi_dir

params.help: Directory holding WSInsight inference outputs.  Must contain a ``model-outputs-csv/`` subdirectory produced by ``wsinsight infer`` or ``wsinsight run``.
params.name: results_dir

params.help: Maximum distance (µm) between neighboring cells in the Delaunay graph.
params.name: ncomp_max_neighbor_distance

params.help: Number of hops that define the neighborhood radius (k-hop).
params.name: ncomp_k

params.help: Recompute and overwrite existing per-slide ncomp outputs.
params.name: overwrite

params.help: Number of slides to process concurrently.
params.name: num_workers

niche.help:
Discover niches across a cohort of slides.

    Builds per-slide Delaunay cell graphs, trains a global Deep Graph Infomax
    (DGI) encoder across all slides, clusters the resulting embeddings, and
    writes per-cell niche labels and annotation-level region merges.

     
    Outputs written to <results-dir>/:
      niche-outputs-csv/cells/<slide>.csv   per-cell niche labels + features
      niche-outputs-csv/niches/<slide>.csv    annotation-level merged niche regions
      niche-outputs-geojson/cells/          GeoJSON cell detections with niche labels
      niche-outputs-geojson/niches/           GeoJSON niche region annotations
niche.name: niche

params.help: Directory containing whole slide images.  Used for slide enumeration and um-per-pixel resolution; images are read only when --hoptimus is set.
params.name: wsi_dir

params.help: Directory holding WSInsight inference outputs.  Must contain a model-outputs-csv/ subdirectory produced by wsinsight infer or wsinsight run.
params.name: results_dir

params.help: Enable H-Optimus tissue morphology features in addition to k-hop cell-type composition.  Requires a GPU and the timm package.
params.name: niche_hoptimus

params.help: Use only H-Optimus features for niche (skip k-hop composition features). Requires --hoptimus.
params.name: niche_hoptimus_only

params.help: Optional PCA components used to reduce H-Optimus embeddings (1536-d) before concatenation with k-hop composition features. If omitted, raw H-Optimus features are used (no PCA). Ignored unless --hoptimus is set.
params.name: niche_hoptimus_pca_dim

params.help: Path to a local directory containing H-Optimus model weights (pytorch_model.bin or model.safetensors). When omitted, weights are downloaded from HuggingFace Hub. Ignored unless --hoptimus is set.
params.name: niche_hoptimus_model_dir

params.help: Number of image patches per H-Optimus forward pass. When omitted (recommended), the batch size is auto-calibrated from available GPU memory at runtime and adapts via binary search if OOM occurs. Set explicitly only to override the automatic sizing (e.g. to cap memory use when sharing the GPU with other workloads). Ignored unless --hoptimus is set.
params.name: niche_hoptimus_batch_size

params.help: Number of KMeans clusters (forces KMeans clustering).  When omitted, the optimal number is determined automatically via a Leiden community-detection sweep (see --leiden-res).
params.name: niche_clusters

params.help: Comma-separated Leiden resolutions to sweep when choosing the number of niches automatically (e.g. '0.2,0.5,1.0,2.0').  Higher resolutions yield more, smaller clusters.  Ignored when --kmeans-clusters is set.
params.name: niche_leiden_res

params.help: Dimensionality of the DGI cell embedding.  Higher values retain more detail but increase computation.  Typical range: 16-64.
params.name: niche_embed_dim

params.help: Upper bound on DGI encoder training epochs.  Early stopping is always active, so training may finish sooner (see --patience, --min-delta and --min-epochs).
params.name: epochs

params.help: Early-stopping patience: stop after this many consecutive epochs without a mean-loss improvement greater than --min-delta.
params.name: early_stop_patience

params.help: Minimum relative mean-loss improvement required to reset the early-stopping patience counter.
params.name: early_stop_min_delta

params.help: Never trigger early stopping before this many epochs have elapsed.
params.name: early_stop_min_epochs

params.help: Enable CUDA automatic mixed precision for DGI training (faster, lower GPU memory).  Off by default.  No effect on CPU/MPS.  Note: FP16 math changes results very slightly versus full FP32.
params.name: amp

params.help: Number of neighborhood hops for the composition features.  Each hop adds one ring of the Delaunay graph, so the spatial extent a niche summarises grows roughly as k-hops x the typical cell spacing.  Raising this also grows the feature dimension linearly and the breadth-first traversal cost superlinearly.
params.name: niche_k_hops

params.help: Maximal Delaunay edge length (um) when building the cell graph.  Longer edges are pruned, so this caps how far a single hop can reach and stops sparse tissue from being wired into spurious neighbourhoods.
params.name: niche_max_edge_len_um

params.help: Maximal cell radius (um) used when merging annotation-level regions.
params.name: niche_max_cell_radius_um

params.help: Use soft (probability) composition features instead of hard argmax labels.  Soft mode keeps the classifier's uncertainty, which helps when many cells have ambiguous class calls.
params.name: niche_soft

params.help: Dirichlet/Laplace smoothing strength for the k-hop composition features: out = (p + alpha / n_classes) / (1 + alpha).  Larger values pull sparse neighbourhoods toward a uniform composition; 0 disables smoothing and allows exact zeros.
params.name: niche_alpha

params.help: Delete cached checkpoints and recompute all niche outputs from scratch.
params.name: overwrite

params.help: Export niche results to GeoJSON files (niche-outputs-geojson/).
params.name: export_geojson

params.help: Number of workers for GeoJSON export.
params.name: num_workers

params.help: Random seed for the full niche pipeline (DGI encoder training, Leiden sweep and KMeans clustering), making the discovered niche ids reproducible across runs.
params.name: seed

niche-profile.help: Summarise each niche's cell composition (and marker genes, if any) to help name niches.
niche-profile.name: niche-profile

params.help: Results directory containing niche-outputs-csv/cells/ from `wsinsight niche`.
params.name: results_dir

params.help: Number of top enriched marker genes to report per niche (if expr_ columns exist).
params.name: top_genes

params.help: Number of top cell types to summarise per niche.
params.name: top_types

patch.help:
Segment tissue and generate patch coordinates for a WSI directory.

    The command validates slide availability, loads either a registered model,
    user-supplied weights, or QuPath-derived pseudo-models, then runs tissue
    segmentation and patch enumeration. Outputs land under
    `RESULTS_DIR/model-outputs-*` for downstream inference.
patch.name: patch

params.help: Directory containing whole slide images. This directory can *only* contain whole slide images.
params.name: wsi_dir

params.help: Hidden argument allowing orchestrators to pass explicit slide paths.
params.name: slide_paths

params.help: Directory to store results. If directory exists, will skip whole slides for which outputs exist.
params.name: results_dir

params.help: Results directory from a prior region-level (patch-based) wsinsight run containing a model-outputs-csv/ folder. Requires --object-based: each detected object is matched to its enclosing region and the region's class probabilities are added as region_prob_* columns in the output.
params.name: region_inference_dir

params.help: Directory of QuPath TSV detection-measurement exports (one <slide>.txt per slide containing 'Centroid X µm', 'Centroid Y µm', classification columns). Patches are extracted as fixed-size squares centered on each centroid. For GeoJSON detection exports, use --qupath-geojson-detection-dir instead.
params.name: qupath_measurement_detection_dir

params.help: Directory containing geojson files generated by QuPath. The detection in the geojson files will be used.
params.name: qupath_geojson_detection_dir

params.help: Directory containing geojson files generated by QuPath. The annotation in the geojson files will be used.
params.name: qupath_geojson_annotation_dir

params.help: The patch size of the pseudo model generated using QuPath detection files.
params.name: qupath_detection_patch_size

params.help: The patch size of the pseudo model generated using QuPath annotation files.
params.name: qupath_annotation_patch_size

params.help: The spacing um/px of the pseudo model generated using QuPath annotation/detection files.
params.name: qupath_spacing_um_px

params.help: When operating QuPath geojson/detection data, using name as class.
params.name: qupath_name_as_class

params.help: Name of the model to use from WSInsight Model Zoo. Mutually exclusive with --config.
params.name: model_name

params.help: Path to configuration for the trained model. Use this option if the model weights are not registered in wsinsight. Mutually exclusive with--model
params.name: config

params.help: Path to the pretrained model. Use only when --config is passed. Mutually exclusive with --model.
params.name: model_path

params.help: Path to a folder containing config.json and torchscript_model.pt. Shorthand for --config + --model-path. Mutually exclusive with --model, --config, and --model-path.
params.name: zoo_model_dir

params.help: Extract image patches and save to hdf5.
params.name: cache_image_patches

params.help: Directory containing histoqc outcomes.
params.name: histoqc_dir

params.help: The size of the slide thumbnail (in pixels) used for tissue segmentation. The aspect ratio is preserved, and the longest side will have length max(thumbsize).
params.name: seg_thumbsize

params.help: The kernel size for median filtering. Must be greater than 1 and odd.
params.name: seg_median_filter_size

params.help: The threshold for image binarization.
params.name: seg_binary_threshold

params.help: The kernel size for binary closing (morphological operation).
params.name: seg_closing_kernel_size

params.help: The minimum size of an object to keep during tissue detection. If a contiguous object is smaller than this area, it replaced with background. The default is 200um x 200um. The units of this argument are microns squared.
params.name: seg_min_object_size_um2

params.help: The minimum size of a hole to keep as a hole. If a hole is smaller than this area, it is filled with foreground. The default is 190um x 190um. The units of this argument are microns squared.
params.name: seg_min_hole_size_um2

params.help: The ratio of overlap among patches. The default value of 0 produces non-overlapping patches. A value in (0, 1) will produce overlapping patches. Negative values will add space between patches. A value of -1 would skip every other patch. A value of 0.5 will provide 50%% of overlap between patches. Values must be in (-inf, 1).
params.name: patch_overlap_ratio

params.help: The size of patch in um. The default value of 0 produces full patch size of the chosen model.
params.name: patch_size_um

params.help: The size of patch in pixel. The default value of 0 produces full patch size of the chosen model.
params.name: patch_size_px

params.help: Fallback slide resolution in micrometres-per-pixel (MPP), used ONLY for slides whose MPP cannot be read from the WSI metadata. Slide metadata is always preferred. The default of 0 disables the fallback.
params.name: spacing_um_px

params.help: Overwrite existing patch/mask outputs instead of skipping slides that already have results.
params.name: overwrite

reg.help:
Register a primary object-CSV against a secondary inference.

    The secondary inference may be a region-level run (``-r``) or another
    object-level run (``-c``); exactly one must be supplied.  Region matching
    uses point-in-bbox containment; object matching uses nearest-neighbour
    KD-tree lookup within ``--radius-um``.  Matched secondary class
    probabilities are appended in-place to the primary CSVs under
    ``region_<tag>_prob_*`` or ``object_<tag>_prob_*`` columns.

    With ``--export-geojson`` or ``--omecsv``, all probability prefix groups
    present in the registered CSVs are exported, one subfolder per group.
reg.name: reg

params.help: If provided, only slides whose filename stem matches a file in this directory are processed.  Image files are not opened; the directory is used for name enumeration only.  Mirrors --wsi-dir in run/infer/hplot for consistent sharding.
params.name: wsi_dir

params.help: Results directory from a prior object-based wsinsight run containing a model-outputs-csv/ folder.
params.name: results_dir

params.help: Results directory from a prior region-level (patch-based) wsinsight run containing a model-outputs-csv/ folder.  Each detected object is matched to its enclosing region and the region's class probabilities are added as region_<tag>_prob_* columns in the object CSVs.  Mutually exclusive with -c.
params.name: region_inference_dir

params.help: Results directory from a prior object-level (cell-based) wsinsight run containing a model-outputs-csv/ folder.  Each primary object is matched to its nearest secondary object within --radius-um and that object's class probabilities are added as object_<tag>_prob_* columns in the primary CSVs.  Mutually exclusive with -r.
params.name: object_inference_dir

params.help: Optional namespace inserted between the kind and 'prob' in the output column names: -r --tag X writes region_X_prob_*; -c --tag X writes object_X_prob_*.  Must match [a-z0-9_]+.  When omitted, the bare default (region_prob_* / object_prob_*) is used; if the bare default already exists, the smallest free integer suffix is auto-picked (region_1_prob_*, object_2_prob_*, ...) unless --overwrite is given.
params.name: tag

params.help: Maximum object-to-object match radius in micrometres.  Only consulted when -c is set.
params.name: radius_um

params.help: Slide pixel size in micrometres-per-pixel, used to convert --radius-um into pixel space.  Only consulted when -c is set.  When -i/--wsi-dir is supplied, this value is treated as a fallback: each slide's MPP is read from the WSI metadata (OpenSlide / TiffSlide / tifffile / Aperio AppMag table) and used in preference; --spacing-um-px is only used for slides whose MPP cannot be read.
params.name: spacing_um_px

params.help: Export registered object CSVs to GeoJSON files.  One subfolder is written per discovered probability prefix (prob, region_*_prob, object_*_prob) under model-outputs-geojson/.
params.name: geojson

params.help: Export registered object CSVs to OME-CSV files.  One subfolder is written per discovered probability prefix under model-outputs-omecsv/.
params.name: omecsv

params.help: Worker processes for GeoJSON/OME-CSV export.
params.name: export_workers

params.help: Overwrite existing columns under the resolved prefix.  Without this flag, slides whose CSV already contains the resolved prefix are skipped with a warning (for explicit --tag) or auto-bumped to the next free integer suffix (for empty --tag).
params.name: overwrite

run.help:
Run both patch extraction and inference workflows for a slide directory.

    The command enumerates slides once, caches the list, and feeds identical
    arguments into the standalone `patch` and `infer` commands. Optional QuPath
    project generation reuses the combined results directory.
run.name: run

params.help: Directory containing whole slide images, or an image-list:///path/to/filelist.txt URI pointing to a text file with one slide path per line (blank lines and # comments ignored).
params.name: wsi_dir

params.help: Directory to store results. If directory exists, will skip whole slides for which outputs exist.
params.name: results_dir

params.help: Results directory from a prior region-level (patch-based) wsinsight run containing a model-outputs-csv/ folder. Requires --object-based: each detected object is matched to its enclosing region and the region's class probabilities are added as region_prob_* columns in the output.
params.name: region_inference_dir

params.help: Directory of QuPath TSV detection-measurement exports (one <slide>.txt per slide containing 'Centroid X µm', 'Centroid Y µm', classification columns). Patches are extracted as fixed-size squares centered on each centroid. For GeoJSON detection exports, use --qupath-geojson-detection-dir instead.
params.name: qupath_measurement_detection_dir

params.help: Directory containing geojson files generated by QuPath. The detection in the geojson files will be used.
params.name: qupath_geojson_detection_dir

params.help: Directory containing QuPath annotation geojson files; their region labels seed the pseudo-model.
params.name: qupath_geojson_annotation_dir

params.help: The patch size of the pseudo model generated using QuPath detection files.
params.name: qupath_detection_patch_size

params.help: The patch size of the pseudo model generated using QuPath annotation files.
params.name: qupath_annotation_patch_size

params.help: The spacing um/px of the pseudo model generated using QuPath annotation/detection files.
params.name: qupath_spacing_um_px

params.help: When operating QuPath geojson/detection data, using name as class.
params.name: qupath_name_as_class

params.help: Name of the model to use from WSInsight Model Zoo. Mutually exclusive with --config.
params.name: model_name

params.help: Path to configuration for the trained model. Use this option if the model weights are not registered in wsinsight. Mutually exclusive with--model
params.name: config

params.help: Path to the pretrained model. Use only when --config is passed. Mutually exclusive with --model.
params.name: model_path

params.help: Path to a folder containing config.json and torchscript_model.pt. Shorthand for --config + --model-path. Mutually exclusive with --model, --config, and --model-path.
params.name: zoo_model_dir

params.help: Batch size during model inference. When omitted (recommended), the batch size is auto-calibrated from available GPU memory at runtime.
params.name: batch_size

params.help: Number of workers to use for data loading during model inference (n=0 for single thread). Set this to the number of cores on your machine or lower.
params.name: num_workers

params.help: Pin DataLoader tensors to CUDA memory for faster host-to-device transfer.  Disable (--no-pin-memory) in memory-constrained environments where DataLoader workers are being killed by the system OOM killer.
params.name: pin_memory

params.help: Extract image patches and save to hdf5.
params.name: cache_image_patches

params.help: Create a QuPath project containing the inference results
params.name: qupath

params.help: Directory containing histoqc outcomes.
params.name: histoqc_dir

params.help: The size of the slide thumbnail (in pixels) used for tissue segmentation. The aspect ratio is preserved, and the longest side will have length max(thumbsize).
params.name: seg_thumbsize

params.help: The kernel size for median filtering. Must be greater than 1 and odd.
params.name: seg_median_filter_size

params.help: The threshold for image binarization.
params.name: seg_binary_threshold

params.help: The kernel size for binary closing (morphological operation).
params.name: seg_closing_kernel_size

params.help: The minimum size of an object to keep during tissue detection. If a contiguous object is smaller than this area, it replaced with background. The default is 200um x 200um. The units of this argument are microns squared.
params.name: seg_min_object_size_um2

params.help: The minimum size of a hole to keep as a hole. If a hole is smaller than this area, it is filled with foreground. The default is 190um x 190um. The units of this argument are microns squared.
params.name: seg_min_hole_size_um2

params.help: The ratio of overlap among patches. The default value of 0 produces non-overlapping patches. A value in (0, 1) will produce overlapping patches. Negative values will add space between patches. A value of -1 would skip every other patch. A value of 0.5 will provide 50%% of overlap between patches. Values must be in (-inf, 1).
params.name: patch_overlap_ratio

params.help: The size of patch in um. The default value of 0 produces full patch size of the chosen model.
params.name: patch_size_um

params.help: The size of patch in pixel. The default value of 0 produces full patch size of the chosen model.
params.name: patch_size_px

params.help: Fallback slide resolution in micrometres-per-pixel (MPP), used ONLY for slides whose MPP cannot be read from the WSI metadata. Slide metadata is always preferred. The default of 0 disables the fallback.
params.name: spacing_um_px

params.help: Run H-Plot analysis.
params.name: hplot

params.help: A parameter of float value determining maximal distance (um) to a neighboring cell.
params.name: hplot_max_neighbor_distance

params.help: Base cell type or cell type list that form(s) the cell cluster(s), e.g., tumor cells.
params.name: hplot_base_types

params.help: Target cell type or cell type list whose layer-wise proportion is computed, e.g., lymphocytes.
params.name: hplot_target_types

params.help: Interpret --hplot-base-types as cell types, niche ids, or aggregate names.
params.name: hplot_base_by

params.help: Interpret --hplot-target-types as cell types, niche ids, or aggregate names. Use 'niche' for a niche's layer-wise fraction (requires --niche); use 'aggregate' for an aggregate's member-cell fraction (requires 'wsinsight agg').
params.name: hplot_target_by

params.help: The maximal edge distance for defining the neighborhood of a cell.
params.name: hplot_k

params.help: The minimal neighborhood size for a cell to be computed for determining tumor regions.
params.name: hplot_n

params.help: The minimal ratio of tumor cells in the neighborhood of a cell, determining is this cell included in a tumor region.
params.name: hplot_r

params.help: The maximal layer index toward OUTSIDE of tumors for the range window of H-Plot.
params.name: hplot_range_max

params.help: The minimal layer index toward INSIDE of tumors for the range window of H-Plot.
params.name: hplot_range_min

params.help: H-Plot computing uses only samples with valid range of cellular-wise layers.
params.name: hplot_samples_with_valid_range_only

params.help: Overwrite existing outputs in all stages instead of skipping slides that already have results.
params.name: overwrite

params.help: Run neighborhood composition (ncomp) analysis after inference.
params.name: ncomp

params.help: Maximum distance (µm) between neighboring cells in the Delaunay graph for ncomp.
params.name: ncomp_max_neighbor_distance

params.help: Number of hops defining the ncomp neighborhood radius.
params.name: ncomp_k

params.help: Run edge-level composition (ecomp) analysis after ncomp.
params.name: ecomp

params.help: Maximum Delaunay edge length (µm) for ecomp; longer edges are pruned.
params.name: ecomp_max_edge

params.help: Number of hops defining the ecomp neighborhood radius (k-hop on the line graph).
params.name: ecomp_k

params.help: Skip line-graph construction and k-hop aggregation for ecomp.  Output one row per Delaunay edge; much faster, no neighborhood_* columns are written.
params.name: ecomp_no_neighborhood

params.help: Run triad-level composition (tcomp) analysis after ecomp.
params.name: tcomp

params.help: Maximum Delaunay edge length (µm) for tcomp; triads with any longer edge are pruned.
params.name: tcomp_max_edge

params.help: Number of hops defining the tcomp neighborhood radius (k-hop on the dual graph).
params.name: tcomp_k

params.help: Skip dual-graph construction and k-hop aggregation for tcomp.  Output one row per Delaunay triad; much faster, no neighborhood_* columns are written.
params.name: tcomp_no_neighborhood

params.help: Run niche analysis after inference.
params.name: niche

params.help: Enable H-Optimus tissue morphology features for niche.  Requires a GPU and the timm package.  Ignored unless --niche is set.
params.name: niche_hoptimus

params.help: Use only H-Optimus features for niche (skip k-hop composition features). Requires --niche-hoptimus and --niche.
params.name: niche_hoptimus_only

params.help: Optional PCA components used to reduce H-Optimus embeddings (1536-d) before concatenation with k-hop features. If omitted, raw H-Optimus features are used (no PCA). Ignored unless --niche-hoptimus and --niche are both set.
params.name: niche_hoptimus_pca_dim

params.help: Path to a local directory containing H-Optimus model weights (pytorch_model.bin or model.safetensors). When omitted, weights are downloaded from HuggingFace Hub. Ignored unless --niche-hoptimus and --niche are both set.
params.name: niche_hoptimus_model_dir

params.help: Number of image patches per H-Optimus forward pass. When omitted (recommended), the batch size is auto-calibrated from available GPU memory at runtime and adapts via binary search if OOM occurs. Set explicitly only to override the automatic sizing. Ignored unless --niche-hoptimus and --niche are both set.
params.name: niche_hoptimus_batch_size

params.help: Number of KMeans clusters (forces KMeans clustering).  When omitted, determined automatically via Leiden community detection (see --niche-leiden-res).  Ignored unless --niche is set.
params.name: niche_clusters

params.help: Comma-separated Leiden resolutions to sweep when choosing the number of niches automatically (e.g. '0.2,0.5,1.0,2.0').  Ignored when --niche-kmeans-clusters is set or --niche is not set.
params.name: niche_leiden_res

params.help: Dimensionality of the niche DGI cell embedding.  Typical range: 16-64.  Ignored unless --niche is set.
params.name: niche_embed_dim

params.help: Upper bound on DGI encoder training epochs for niche.  Early stopping is always active, so training may finish sooner.  Ignored unless --niche is set.
params.name: niche_epochs

params.help: Early-stopping patience for niche DGI training: stop after this many consecutive epochs without a mean-loss improvement greater than --niche-min-delta.  Ignored unless --niche is set.
params.name: niche_patience

params.help: Minimum relative mean-loss improvement required to reset the niche early-stopping patience counter.  Ignored unless --niche is set.
params.name: niche_min_delta

params.help: Never trigger niche early stopping before this many epochs have elapsed.  Ignored unless --niche is set.
params.name: niche_min_epochs

params.help: Enable CUDA automatic mixed precision for niche DGI training (faster, lower GPU memory).  Off by default.  No effect on CPU/MPS.  Ignored unless --niche is set.
params.name: niche_amp

params.help: Number of neighborhood hops for the niche composition features.  Each hop adds one ring of the Delaunay graph, so the spatial extent a niche summarises grows roughly as k-hops x the typical cell spacing.  Ignored unless --niche is set.
params.name: niche_k_hops

params.help: Maximal Delaunay edge length (um) when building the niche cell graph.  Longer edges are pruned, capping how far a single hop can reach.  Ignored unless --niche is set.
params.name: niche_max_edge_len_um

params.help: Maximal cell radius (um) used when merging annotation-level niche regions.  Ignored unless --niche is set.
params.name: niche_max_cell_radius_um

params.help: Use soft (probability) composition features for niche instead of hard argmax labels.  Ignored unless --niche is set.
params.name: niche_soft

params.help: Dirichlet/Laplace smoothing strength for the niche k-hop composition features: out = (p + alpha / n_classes) / (1 + alpha).  0 disables smoothing.  Ignored unless --niche is set.
params.name: niche_alpha

params.help: Random seed for the niche pipeline (DGI training, Leiden sweep and KMeans clustering), making discovered niche ids reproducible.  Ignored unless --niche is set.
params.name: niche_seed

params.help: Run 'wsinsight import' after inference to map spatial-transcriptomics expression onto the H&E cells. Requires --import-sptx-dir. Use --import-platform to select the input format.
params.name: run_import

params.help: sptx-list:// manifest for 'wsinsight import'. For --import-platform=xenium: paths to Xenium output directories. For --import-platform=xenium-h5ad: paths to sptxinsight annotated.h5ad files. Required when --import is set.
params.name: import_sptx_dir

params.help: Input platform for 'wsinsight import'. 'xenium': raw Xenium output directories (cells.parquet + cell_feature_matrix.h5). 'xenium-h5ad': sptxinsight annotated.h5ad; the sptx-list 3rd column supplies the per-sample transform directory.
params.name: import_platform

params.help: (--import-platform=xenium-h5ad only) obsm key for cell centroids in microns.
params.name: import_spatial_key

params.help: Comma-separated per-cell sources to merge into the imported h5ad (niche, hplot, ncomp). Passed as --include to 'wsinsight import'. Ignored unless --import is set.
params.name: import_include

params.help: After inference, merge all per-cell analytics and export to GeoJSON files (export-geojson/).  Equivalent to running 'wsinsight export --geojson'.
params.name: export_geojson

params.help: After inference, merge all per-cell analytics and export to compressed OME-CSV files (export-omecsv/).  Equivalent to running 'wsinsight export --omecsv'.
params.name: export_omecsv

params.help: After inference, merge all per-cell analytics and export to AnnData .h5ad files (export-h5ad/).  Equivalent to running 'wsinsight export --h5ad'.
params.name: export_h5ad

params.help: Thread pool size used when TileFuse stitches object-based detections during inference.
params.name: stitch_workers

params.help: Worker processes for the merged export stage.  When omitted, defaults to min(4, CPU count).
params.name: export_workers

params.help: Object type recorded for exported GeoJSON/h5ad features.
params.name: export_object_type

params.help: Run cell-type aggregate (agg) analysis after inference.  Requires --agg-name and --agg-types.
params.name: agg

params.help: Product label for the aggregate (lower-case [a-z0-9_]+), e.g. 'tls'.  Required when --agg is set.
params.name: agg_name

params.help: Comma-separated ingredient cell types for the aggregate, e.g. 't_cell,b_cell'.  Required when --agg is set.
params.name: agg_types

params.help: Maximum distance (µm) between neighboring cells in the Delaunay graph for agg.
params.name: agg_max_neighbor_distance

params.help: k-hop neighborhood radius for the agg density gate.
params.name: agg_k

params.help: Minimum neighborhood size for a cell to be inside an aggregate region.
params.name: agg_n

params.help: Minimum fraction of ingredient cells in the neighborhood (agg density gate).
params.name: agg_r

params.help: Drop aggregates with fewer than this many cells.
params.name: agg_min_size

tcomp.help:
Compute triad-level neighborhood composition for WSInsight inference outputs.

    For every Delaunay triad (triangle of three cells), the k-hop neighboring
    triads are collected from the dual graph and the proportion of each triad
    type in that neighborhood is recorded, together with per-triad geometric
    features (area, perimeter, regularity, max edge length).

     
    Outputs written to <results-dir>/:
      tcomp-outputs-csv/<slide_id>.csv   per-triad neighborhood composition
tcomp.name: tcomp

params.help: Directory containing whole slide images.  Used only to enumerate slides and to resolve µm-per-pixel spacing; images are not fully read during tcomp.
params.name: wsi_dir

params.help: Directory holding WSInsight inference outputs.  Must contain a ``model-outputs-csv/`` subdirectory produced by ``wsinsight infer`` or ``wsinsight run``.
params.name: results_dir

params.help: Maximum triad edge length (µm); triads whose longest edge exceeds this are dropped.
params.name: tcomp_max_edge

params.help: Number of hops that define the triad-level neighborhood radius (k-hop on the dual graph).
params.name: tcomp_k

params.help: Recompute and overwrite existing per-slide tcomp outputs.
params.name: overwrite

params.help: Number of slides to process concurrently.
params.name: num_workers

params.help: Skip dual-graph construction and k-hop aggregation.  Output one row per Delaunay triad with geometry, cell types, triad type, and a ``centroid_region`` column (derived from per-vertex ``region_prob_*`` columns).  Much faster; no ``neighborhood_*`` columns are written.
params.name: no_neighborhood
